sentences.v01: The bakery opens at seven. I bought two loaves, and I carried them home in a bag.
sentences.v02: My cousin called on Friday. She had moved house, and she wanted to give me the address.
sentences.v03: The ferry was full this morning. We stood on the deck, and we watched the harbour pass.
sentences.v04: I swept the porch after breakfast. The leaves had piled up, so it took a little while.
sentences.v05: The clock in the hall stopped. I wound it again, and it kept time for the rest of the day.
sentences.v06: We found the map in a drawer. It was old and creased, but the roads were still clear.
sentences.v07: The plumber came on Wednesday. He replaced the tap, and the kitchen sink stopped dripping.
sentences.v08: I left the umbrella by the door. It was still wet, so I opened it to let it dry.
sentences.v09: Our street was closed for repairs. The buses took another route, and I walked the last part.
sentences.v10: The museum was quiet on Monday. We saw the new gallery, and then we had coffee upstairs.
sentences.v11: I ironed the shirts last night. There were six of them, and I hung them in the wardrobe.
sentences.v12: The dog waited by the gate. I filled its bowl, and it drank before we went out.
sentences.v13: We booked the tickets in March. The flight leaves at noon, so we will take the early train.
sentences.v14: The lamp on the desk flickered. I changed the bulb, and the light was steady again.
sentences.v15: My neighbour borrowed the ladder. He cleaned his gutters, and he returned it the same evening.
sentences.v16: The bread was still warm. I cut two slices, and I put the rest in the tin.
sentences.v17: I counted the chairs in the room. There were twelve, so we brought two more from the hall.
sentences.v18: The river was high after the rain. We crossed by the bridge, and we kept to the path.
sentences.v19: She sent the parcel on Tuesday. It arrived two days later, and nothing inside was broken.
sentences.v20: The heating came on at six. The house was warm by seven, so I opened a window.
sentences.v21: I washed the car on Saturday. It rained that evening, but the windows stayed clean.
sentences.v22: The teacher handed back the papers. Mine had three corrections, and I fixed them at home.
sentences.v23: We painted the bedroom blue. It took two coats, and the smell was gone by Thursday.
sentences.v24: The market sets up before dawn. I went at eight, and most of the fruit was already sold.
